violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: beef shawarma=50F, shredded lettuce=44F, cooked lamb=44F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Relocated . CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw meet, and chicken were observed placed above vegetables and cooked foods, inside refrigerators.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. (Foods were properly rearranged, preventing possible;e cross-contamination).

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring devices in several mechanically refrigerated units were missing.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a thermometer in each refrigerator to monitor the air temperature properly.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Excessive waste oil buildup in catch basins, under cooking equipment at the hood system, were noted to be in need of cleaning..
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. Broken equipment, that are no longer going to be repaired are to be removed from the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. ERBIL KABOB (Inspection Date: 02/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles in the food preparation area are in need of cleaning or repainting to remove the discoloration caused by smoke.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at kitchden handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Provided during the inspection.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CORRECTED DURING THGE INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Lamb cooked and held for here days, was not date marked to show prep or use-by-date.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door to the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. You install a screen door at this door to prevent the entry of flies and other insects. ERBIL KABOB (Inspection Date: 08/27/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food bags and boxes were observed stored feed on the floor, in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employee in the kitchen observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Carry-out single service food containers were found stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: The bottom storage compartments inside refrigerators and freezers.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles are missing in some areas. Vent system in THYE kitchen hen. May not be pulling. Sufficiently air, or not maintained in good properly. The ceiling tiles are heavily stained with heat or smoke stains.. The concrete step at the back door en trance top the kitchen, is broken.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors under stationary equip[ment such as cooking equipment under thew exhaust hood system, storage shelving, floor under refrigerators and freezers, and work tables, is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Keep the floor in these areas in clean condition at all times. Clean floors more often to prevent dirt build-up.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: EHS observed no employee health policy in place during time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS emailed PIC employee health policy during inspection. ERBIL KABOB (Inspection Date: 01/27/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided PIC a copy of the bodily fluids clean up poster during inspection.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. PIC did not have a thermometer at the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC acquired a food thermometer during inspection.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed rice scoop being stored in cooked rice so handle cannot be reached without touching the RTE foods
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed rice scoop from RTE food

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. PIC did not have a quaternary ammonia test during beginning of inspection
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a quaternary ammonia test kit during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS observed step in the back of the kitchen not smooth or easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. PIC agreed to have steps in the back of the kitchen repaired.
